set.body: A second session, a human, or another tool can file a GitHub issue with no worklog marker, or close a linked issue on GitHub while the log item stays open. Push-only treated the log as source of truth, so those orphans were invisible and a later dirty push could rewrite tickets GitHub already closed. Sync now reports unmarked remotes as first-class drift, worklog adopt absorbs one by creating the log item and stamping the marker, and a linked ticket closed remotely closes the log item instead of pushing the open state back.
set.title: Push-only sync absorbs unmarked remotes and closed-on-remote drift

set.resolution: Merged #386; unmarked remotes are first-class drift, worklog adopt stamps the marker, closed-on-remote closes locally instead of pushing open state back.
